subject: Saving calculated differential methylation p-values and q-values to file

messages.author: 0490c034b26c6223
messages.subject: Saving calculated differential methylation p-values and q-values to file
parts:
What command would you use or is it possible to save a file of all the calculated differential methylation p-values and q-values for every interrogated C to a file from the below step or any other step within methylKit. Thanks

# calculate differential methylation p-values and q-values
 
myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth,num.cores=40)

Dave

messages.author: e4181d5c40fc094c
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Saving calculated differential methylation p-values and q-values to file
parts:
Something like this may work:

#Beware of the typos in calling functions below
>diff_as_dataframe=getData(myDiff)
>dataframe_as_table=write.table(diff_as_dataframe, file="diff.txt", quote=F, col.names=T, row.names=F)
#Instead of getData one may also convert it into "GRanges" first and then into dataframe using as.data.frame function in R

Regards,
Kalyan
